thread:
sarah_sales: Hey team — RivetBank procurement is asking for a short assurance bundle for the POC. They want: redacted SOC 2 AOC, ISO27001 certificate excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation/letter, and a high-level network diagram. Need to know who can sign the pen-test letter and whether we can get the other artifacts to them within 10 business days. Also asking about any dedicated/staging pricing delta.

andrew_security: @sarah_sales we can provide a redacted SOC 2 AOC and ISO excerpt. For the pen-test letter — legal usually signs, but we need the customer's template or the fields they require (scope, contact, date). Can you attach the template?

sarah_sales: attaching their procurement template in a follow-up DM. They want explicit scope: "staging.redwood.io" + dedicated GPU pool (if we use Dedicated). They also asked that the pen-test letter note we allow vendor red-team ops limited to staging.

mike_eng: FYI if they want dedicated GPU pool in the POC there is a pricing delta. Rough ballpark: +25% monthly over hosted for the reserved mini-pool, and we need network whitelist + peering. Also need to confirm whether KMS/staging creds are allowed for their security team to run scans.

lucy_devex: I can prep a one-page runbook + presigned upload link for artifacts. For uploads we usually share a presigned S3 and a short checklist: validators we run before handing off. Example presign command:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/rivetbank/POC-2024-09.zip --expires-in 604800
```
I'll attach the runbook once legal confirms redaction rules for SOC2.

kate_legal: @andrew_security @sarah_sales I can sign the pen-test attestation but need two things before signing: (1) final scope text (exact hostnames + whether Dedicated is covered), (2) PO or SOW reference + billing entity (for our records). We can sign an attestation on company letterhead, not a full warranty. Timeline: I can turn around within 3 business days after receiving the two items.

andrew_security: For scope: propose wording — "Scope: testing restricted to staging.redwood.io and associated staging infrastructure for RivetBank POC. Redwood Inference will not allow production scans. Dedicated pool included if customer purchases Dedicated POC add-on." Confirm?

sarah_sales: That wording looks good to me. For PO — RivetBank procurement said they'll issue a short PO once we confirm pricing. They asked for a quote for a 2-week Dedicated POC window + SOC2/ISO artifacts. I'll push for the PO today.

mike_eng: One operational blocker: if they insist on on-prem connectivity (IP seeding) for the pen test, we need a networking window and an ops runbook. If it's just staging in our cloud + presigned uploads for results, that's straightforward.

sarah_sales: Procurement prefers hosted staging but may request a private peering test. I'll ask which they prefer and flag the networking window.

lucy_devex: Also note: our standard redaction for SOC2 removes customer names and IPs and redacts internal hostnames. If they need full unredacted report for procurement, we need a signed NDA.

kate_legal: Correct — unredacted SOC2/shared report requires an NDA and there's an internal review. For most POCs, redacted AOC + ISO excerpt + signed pen-test attestation suffices.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: New presigned upload bucket created: s3://redwood-evidence/rivetbank/ (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

andrew_security: Next steps: @sarah_sales please get the customer template/PO preference and confirm whether Dedicated is requested. @kate_legal will sign once scope and PO/SOW are provided. @lucy_devex will prepare presign link + runbook. @mike_eng will estimate network window if peering required.

sarah_sales: Will do — pinging RivetBank now. Expect update by EOD. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
